description: Texas Instruments TPS2553DBVR precision adjustable current-limited power-distribution switch. Active-high EN, open-drain FAULT, programmable constant-current limit, 2.5-6.5 V input, 1.5 A continuous to 105 C, DBV SOT-23-6.
name: tps2553dbvr

provenance.source: TI SLVS841F DBV package drawing and pin-function table

watch_out_for: TPS2553 is constant-current (not TPS2553-1 latch-off). Pin 3 is active-high EN; pin 4 is open-drain FAULT and needs a pull-up. TI specifies 15-232 kOhm 1% RILIM from pin 5 to GND, 0.1 uF or larger ceramic from IN to GND close to the IC, and output bulk capacitance for transient loads. DBV pinout: 1 IN, 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 FAULT, 5 ILIM, 6 OUT.
